o1.biggest_strength: Strong, warm creator scripts with three distinct, data-backed angles and a clean three-hook testing plan.
o1.biggest_mistake: Paid disclosure is only a global rule/caption note, not written into each script’s first frame or spoken line, and production deliverables/rights are missing.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Bake the Meta/TikTok paid partnership disclosure into each script and add creator deliverables and usage rights without losing the warm, natural voice.

o2.biggest_strength: Most production-ready: every script has on-screen and spoken ad disclosure, exact claims, price math, deliverables/rights, and a budgeted hook test plan.
o2.biggest_mistake: A few continuity/creator-naturalness slips, such as the blind-test ending on “both clink cans” after one drink was a regular soda in a glass.
o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Fix the continuity issues and loosen a few lines so they sound more like a real creator and less like an ad read, while keeping the compliance and test plan.

reason: I’d shoot 2 first because the paid disclosure, deliverables and budgeted hook test are already built in. I’d steal a few warmer lines from 1, but 2 is the safer, more usable package.
